description: A country picker with flags and dial codes, plus the number. Submits one international number, +60123456789. Works with Livewire wire:model.

consider.note: The country picker only shapes the number in the browser. Check the format on the server (E.164: `regex:/^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$/`, or a phone validation package), and don't treat a number as verified until a code sent to it comes back.

If you text the number, each SMS is billed, and some countries cost far more than others. Consider throttling per number and per IP, and only sending to the countries you serve, so the form can't be used to run up texts.
